title: Map file extensions and content types
goal: Look up a known media type from a filename or extension and one extension from a media type; use for labels, with explicit unknown handling and separate content validation.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.
language.name: C#

packageAssets: Framework reference/runtime assemblies; no NuGet package route.
prerequisites: Nullable/implicit-usings console net11.0 project; canonical types called from the same assembly.
Use host Path.GetExtension semantics; parse URLs separately and preserve any fixed application mapping policy.
platforms: Framework lookup; Windows x64 path/string/span cases executed, other platform path rules unverified.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: Mapping does not validate file bytes or make untrusted uploads safe; keep format/authorization/serving policy separate.
Unknowns return null; string null throws. Reverse lookup selects one suffix and does not recover an original name. Table choices may evolve.
